messages.content: Summarize the incident in one sentence. Incident: disk full on db-03 at 02:14.
A full disk on db-03 at 02:14 blocked writes for about twelve minutes.
Summarize the incident in one sentence. Incident: certificate expired on the gateway at 09:00.
An expired gateway certificate at 09:00 rejected client connections until it was renewed.
Summarize the incident in one sentence. Incident: a deploy rolled back after a failed health check.
A deploy failed its health check and was rolled back automatically within four minutes.
Summarize the incident in one sentence. Incident: queue backlog grew after a consumer restart.
A consumer restart left the queue backlogged for thirty minutes before it drained.
